english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for fixing or mending something in everyday speech.

exampleSentences.english: My phone broke, so I took it in for repair.
exampleSentences.jyutping: bou6 din6 waa2 waai6 zo2 ngo5 ling1 heoi3 zing2

english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for physically repairing a broken or damaged object.

exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 baa2 laan6 dang3 ngo5 lei4 zing2 laa1

english.note: Use this when the tinkering specifically involves physically repairing or adjusting an object, machine, or device.

exampleSentences.english: The fan is broken, so I'll try to tinker with it myself.
exampleSentences.traditional: 部風扇壞咗，我試下自己整。
exampleSentences.jyutping: bou6 fung1 sin3 waai6 zo2 ngo5 si3 haa5 zi6 gei2 zing2
